sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trip_count, ROUND(SUM(yt) / COUNT(*), 2) as yt_per_trip FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 287 AND 305 AND avail_t <= 608.875 GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy

import pandas as pd

# Check recent data (late summer dead zone)
late_summer = tables['trips'][(tables['trips']['fish_date_season'] == 2) & 
                              (tables['trips']['fish_date_doy'] >= 200) & 
                              (tables['trips']['fish_date_doy'] <= 244)]

late_summer_summary = late_summer.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'count', 'mean'],
    'anglers': 'mean'
}).round(2)
late_summer_summary.columns = ['yt_total', 'trips', 'yt_per_trip', 'avg_anglers']
print("=== LATE SUMMER DEAD ZONE (DOY 200-244, S2) ===")
print(late_summer_summary.tail(20))

# Check water temperature trend
pier_temp = tables['pier'][tables['pier']['ts_season'] == 2]
pier_latest = pier_temp[pier_temp['ts_doy'] >= 240].sort_values('ts_doy', ascending=False)
print("\n=== WATER TEMPERATURE (Last 5 days) ===")
print(pier_latest[['ts_doy', 'wtmp_c']].head(10))

# Estimate current temp in Fahrenheit
if len(pier_latest) > 0:
    latest_c = pier_latest.iloc[0]['wtmp_c']
    latest_f = latest_c * 9/5 + 32
    print(f"\nLatest: {latest_c}°C = {latest_f:.1f}°F")

# Check Season 1 historical data for October peak (DOY 287-305)
s1_oct_peak = tables['trips'][(tables['trips']['fish_date_season'] == 1) & 
                               (tables['trips']['fish_date_doy'] >= 287) & 
                               (tables['trips']['fish_date_doy'] <= 305)]

s1_peak_summary = s1_oct_peak.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'count', 'mean'],
    'anglers': 'mean'
}).round(2)
s1_peak_summary.columns = ['yt_total', 'trips', 'yt_per_trip', 'avg_anglers']

print("=== SEASON 1 OCTOBER PEAK (DOY 287-305) ===")
print(s1_peak_summary)

# Calculate my expected personal share
print("\n=== EXPECTED PERSONAL SHARE (22 anglers, solo boat) ===")
for doy in [287, 288, 289, 295, 297, 301]:
    if doy in s1_peak_summary.index:
        yt_per_trip = s1_peak_summary.loc[doy, 'yt_per_trip']
        # Assume 22 anglers + 1-2 competitors on boat
        share_1comp = yt_per_trip / (22 + 1)
        share_2comp = yt_per_trip / (22 + 2)
        print(f"DOY {doy}: {yt_per_trip:.1f} yt/trip → {share_1comp:.2f} (1 comp) or {share_2comp:.2f} (2 comp) personal share")
